scope: Original NPC stop/area callbacks and SceneTreeTimer return gate, isolated from sprite/movement/dialogue services. Reference only; NPC timer execution not yet integrated.

semantics.stop: Clears talking, interaction pause and mute; non-staring NPC adds a one-second timer
semantics.view_enter: Only player identity and staring set looking true
semantics.view_exit: Only matching player/staring clears looking; stationary NPC adds a one-second timer
semantics.return: On callback, only not-looking and not-interacting restore initial direction. Timers are not cancelled by a later interaction or re-entry.
